description: Detect circular imports in a module graph. Reports exactly one representative cycle per cyclic strongly connected component (not all elementary cycles), plus single-node self-loops, each with the exact cycle nodes and edges and a suggested break point whose target has the fewest dependents in the graph.

modules.description: Modules in the graph; each entry names a module path and the paths it imports

imports.description: Paths this module imports (may be empty)

name: find_import_cycles
